svg.title: The signing journal: write, sync, then sign; read it back at restart
svg.desc: Before any signature, a validator first appends the block it is about to sign over to signing_journal.blocks.jsonl and syncs it, then appends a record of the signature it is about to produce to signing_journal.jsonl and syncs it: format version, chain id, kind, level, round, block hash, signed valid round, the lock and valid state after the step, and the pre-endorsement certificate of the valid round. Only then does it sign and send. A crash before the signature is harmless: no signature exists yet, and a record already written only forbids signing something else there. At restart the node restores the lock, the valid round with its certificate after checking it against the validator set, the round of the level in progress and the kept blocks, validated again, and refuses to sign anything that conflicts with a record. A journal that cannot be trusted is moved aside and the validator does not sign at the level in progress: it fails closed. No measured number appears in the figure.
svg.text: The signing journal: write, sync, then sign
a lock never names a block the node could lose, and a restarted validator cannot sign twice
Before every signature (PROPOSE, PREENDORSE, ENDORSE, self-commit)
1 Keep the block
append it to
signing_journal.blocks.jsonl
and sync to disk
2 Record the signature
append to signing_journal.jsonl
and sync: kind, level, round,
block hash, signed valid round,
lock, valid round, its certificate
3 Sign and send
only now is the signature
produced and broadcast
a crash before step 3 is harmless: no signature exists yet, and a record left by step 2 only forbids signing something else there
At restart
Restore and refuse
the lock (round, block) of the level in progress
the valid round, with its certificate, checked
against the validator set before use
the round, and the kept blocks, validated again
refuse any signature that conflicts with a record:
same kind, level, round, another block or valid round
Fail closed
a journal that is unreadable, in an older format,
for another chain, or with a malformed record, and a
missing journal on a chain past genesis: moved aside;
the validator does not sign at the level in progress,
and resumes once others have finalized it
a final line cut by a crash: ignored, or removed
Kept small
records below the finalized height are compacted every 64 levels; a certificate that fails its check costs liveness, never safety
consensus-wire.md, Phase E (Signing journal); consensus-locking.md sections 9.2, 10.5 to 10.7
